patronOf.en-US: Father and teacher of the young

prayerExcerpt.en-US: Give me souls, and take away everything else.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Dai-me almas e ficai com o resto.

meta.face: A sturdy man of about fifty with a square, clean-shaven face, broad high cheekbones, thick wavy dark-brown hair with the first grey, brushed back from the forehead, lively dark eyes and a broad, warm, fatherly smile.
meta.basis: His photographs, above all the one taken in Turin in 1880: a square peasant face, prominent cheekbones, curly hair brushed back and a broad smile. We take him at about fifty and leave out the tiredness of the last photographs.
meta.excerpt: His motto 'Da mihi animas, caetera tolle', on the card on his wall, as told in his own Life of Dominic Savio (1859), ch. 8; English as in the SDB translation; pt-BR is the usual Brazilian Salesian rendering
